title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: vertexcolor
text:
vertex coloring
vertex coloring
(definition)
Definition:
An assignment of colors (or any distinct marks) to the
vertices
of a
graph
.  Strictly speaking, a coloring is
proper
if no two
adjacent
vertices have the same color.
See also
edge coloring
,
k-coloring
,
vertex cover
,
chromatic number
.
